Query: which type of online advertising is extended by the same type?
Rationale: The Candidate fails to capture the core logic of the query as defined in the Ground Truth LISP. The LISP describes a two-hop traversal: finding a Type (T1) that is extended by another entity (T2), which in turn extends 'Online_Advertising' (T1 -> T2 -> Online_Advertising). The Candidate only models a single relationship between two entities and introduces a constraint on a 'type' attribute (e1.type = e2.type) that is not present in the LISP. Most importantly, it completely omits the 'Online_Advertising' entity and its associated relationship, which is the anchor of the query.
